rationale: Independently reviewed the full two-file adapter diff, both original immutable Jev receipts and exact arguments, retained two-check manifest and complete logs, and the surrounding review_status implementation. The real jev_verify receipt has valid per-claim verdict, confidence and action but no aggregate action; deriving review when any validated claim action is review is correct and preserves independent resolution. Aggregate derivation occurs only after every claim identity/count/verdict/action is validated, and invalid confidence, missing claim actions, wrong subjects, contradicted claims, mismatched receipts and operational errors still block even when an approval record is supplied. Existing top-level auto output cannot hide a review or unsupported result. The regression executes the actual no-top-level format, verified review and verified auto cases, then independently fails missing/unknown actions, contradictions, negative confidence and wrong subjects; existing tests retain malformed/provider-error/stale-receipt/nonfinite/missing-claim controls. The retained run shows Ruff passed and all4 review-payload tests passed with exit0. This resolves patch correctness confidence0 and the otherwise verified claim confidence.58 through code/negative-control inspection. Approval covers only this adapter bundle and does not overwrite original judgments or bypass genuine operational failures.
